CloudflareConfig.CloudflareConfig__Description: Cloudflare Worker used by the localhost Dev menu to read/write project data and presentation scene thumbnails directly to R2 (no GitHub push required).

Scene__Environment.Scene__Environment__Description: HDR environment map settings. Mirror-only mode keeps the rest of the model neutral while applying reflections to the targeted mirror material.

Scene__Default__FogConfig.Scene__Default__FogConfig__Description: Default orbit-cube anchored fog envelope. Distances are integer millimeters and must be converted to 3D units in code.

RenderConfig__Linework.RenderConfig__Linework__ProjectionOnlyNo: Model categories whose linework belongs to 2D DRAWINGS ONLY. The SketchUp linetype tags - dashed, dotted, centre, door swings, clearances, overhead extents, building joins, demolition - say what a line MEANS on a drawing, and mean nothing in a 3D render: drawn there they sit in mid air, and on a drawing that shows a rendered underlay they appear twice, solid in the raster beneath their own dashes. Their fat lines are therefore loaded with material.visible false, so no 3D render draws them - the viewer, the image export and the Layout Editor raster alike - while the objects stay in the scene graph at full visibility for the projected linework pipeline to read. Matched case-insensitively as substrings of the category name; empty the list to draw them in 3D again.

RenderConfig__InstanceConsolidation.RenderConfig__InstanceConsolidation__Des: Collapses repeated mesh nodes that share the same geometry + material (e.g. thousands of instanced plant leaves) into a single THREE.InstancedMesh at load time, turning N draw calls into 1. Interactive/door assemblies are guarded out. MinInstanceCount is the threshold below which consolidation is skipped.

RenderEffect__ProfileLines.RenderEffect__ProfileLines__Description: Profile lines render silhouette edges around curved/rounded geometry, similar to SketchUp profile lines.
RenderEffect__ProfileLines.RenderEffect__ProfileLines__Drawing2d__D: The same silhouette edges applied to the 2D drawings - floor plans and elevations. A parallel view has no shading, so without this every rounded form (curved walls, cylinders, bay windows, downpipes) reads as a blank patch on the sheet. Width is FIXED here rather than scaled by camera distance, because a drawn line keeps its weight on the sheet at any zoom. Colour and threshold fall back to the 3D values above when omitted.
RenderEffect__ProfileLines.RenderEffect__ProfileLines__Drawing2dEdg: Removed 13-Sep-2026 (v2.27.0). Drawing2dEdgeWidth 0.55 set only the live floor plan and elevation views' profile width - their profile pass is initialised from this block - and with the key gone they take the same built-in 0.55. It never reached a Layout Editor bake: TrueVision did not register this config with the drawing view until 13-Sep-2026, so every bake drew at 1.0. The bake width is now the profileLinework Composite__Weight in 51__System__LayoutEditor/Na__LayoutEditor__RenderComposites__Config__.json (default 1.0, per viewport). Re-adding Drawing2dEdgeWidth here would set the live views again and, now that the config is registered, the width the render preset re-applies around a bake.

RenderEffect__ProgressiveRefine.RenderEffect__ProgressiveRefine__Descrip: Idle-time supersampled anti-aliasing for the LIVE 3D viewport. Costs nothing while the camera moves. Once the camera has held still for SettleDebounceMs the render loop keeps going instead of idling, redrawing the same frame with sub-pixel jitter and averaging, until the viewport holds a full SampleCount image. Image export does its own supersampling and is not affected by anything here. The 2D drawing views are excluded.

RenderEffect__AmbientOcclusion.RenderEffect__AmbientOcclusion__Descript: Screen-space ambient occlusion. RadiusMm sets the world-space sampling radius controlling shadow strip width at geometry junctions. BlurRadius (1-3) controls the gaussian smoothing applied after AO to reduce noise. Distance values are integer millimeters; convert to 3D units in code.
RenderEffect__AmbientOcclusion.RenderEffect__AmbientOcclusion__CullDist: CullDistanceMm skips the kernel for pixels further than this from the CAMERA, and fades over the last 20% (so 50000 means full strength to 40m, gone by 50m). Because it measures camera distance, every pixel crosses it at once: set it below the orbit range and the whole image loses its shading together as you pull back, which reads as the effect switching off rather than falling away. Keep it at or above Navmode__MouseControls__OrbitMaxDistanceMm (45000) for that reason. It was 8000 until 19-Sep-2026, which was inside the orbit range. Measured cost of 8000 -> 50000 on an RTX 3080 at 2560x1440: under 0.15ms per frame. 0 disables culling entirely.
RenderEffect__AmbientOcclusion.RenderEffect__AmbientOcclusion__SamplesN: Samples is the kernel CEILING: the shader loop is unrolled at that length and nothing can exceed it, so raising it recompiles the shader. SamplesWhileMoving is how many of them an ordinary moving frame walks - the image nobody studies - and it is the only lever that makes live navigation cheaper. The parked image is NOT limited by either: progressive refinement runs the full Samples kernel once per supersample with a different rotation each time, so a settled 16-sample burst converges on roughly Samples x 16 effective directions. Lowering Samples therefore trades settle SPEED against still QUALITY, while lowering SamplesWhileMoving trades only moving quality and costs the still nothing.

RenderEffect__DistanceCulling.RenderEffect__DistanceCulling__Descripti: Hides furniture and interior-decor items beyond CullDistanceMm from the active camera to reduce render load. Distance is integer millimeters; converted to 3D units in code. CategoryNameTokens selects which loaded GLB categories are affected (matched against category keys). CullDistanceMm is the global default only - a per-model override is stored as RenderEffect__AssetCullDistanceMm in that project TrueVision__ProjectData__.json, set via Dev Tools > Orbit Max Zoom Radius > Asset Cull Distance.

ImageExport__Panel.ImageExport__Panel__Description: Custom export panel settings: aspect ratio, resolution, custom mode toggle, and how many sub-pixel samples each tile is averaged from.
ImageExport__Panel.ImageExport__Panel__AntiAliasSamplesNote: Renders each tile this many times with sub-pixel camera jitter and averages the results, so a near-horizontal eaves or a sub-pixel glazing bar records how much of each pixel it really covers instead of winning or losing the pixel outright. Only 1 (off), 2, 4, 8 and 16 exist; anything else rounds down. Resolution is not a substitute - a bigger image gets smaller steps, not fewer - and FXAA cannot repair it, because a step on a two-degree line is longer than FXAA can see along. 16 because a still is one frame and whitecard line work is the case that needs every level. The cost is linear: 16 samples is 16 renders.

Navmode__Settings.Navmode__Settings__Description: All navmode values are integer millimeters where noted; convert to 3D units in code.

Navmode__WalkMode.Navmode__WalkMode__Description: First-person walk mode settings. All distance values are integer millimeters; convert to 3D units in code.

Navmode__FlyMode.Navmode__FlyMode__Description: Free-flying camera mode. No gravity, no collision. Movement is relative to the camera's current orientation so 'forward' follows where the user is looking. All distance values are integer millimeters; convert to 3D units in code.

Navmode__Damping.Navmode__Damping__Description: Orbit-controls damping settings. Factor values are unitless scalar values (not millimeters).

Camera__DefaultPosition.Camera__DefaultPosition__Description: All camera position/target values are integer millimeters; convert to 3D units in code.

Dev__DeveloperMode.Dev__DeveloperMode__Description: All Dev__DefaultCube values are integer millimeters; convert to 3D units in code.

ImageExport__PostProcessEffects.ImageExport__PostProcessEffects__Descrip: All post process effects applied to the image export before download are configured here.

MaterialsSystem__Config.MaterialsSystem__Config__Description: Configuration for the PBR materials swap system. When enabled, GLB material names matching the DataLib library are replaced with PBR materials. Unmatched materials retain the whitecard appearance. Library data is loaded at startup by AppCore__DataLib__Loader.js from the GitHub raw URL — no local library file is required.

3dObject__Interaction__DoorAnimation.3dObject__Interaction__DoorAnimation__De: Interactive door animation settings for click and Walk/Fly proximity. Explicitly token-matched exterior-double ADRs click per leaf; Walk/Fly couples unfixed pairs and retains nearest-eligible behavior for FIXED assemblies. Interior, bifold, sliding, and unknown ADRs retain the unified lockstep pipeline.

3dObject__Interaction__CameraFollowCompo.3dObject__Interaction__CameraFollow__Des: 2D camera-follow billboard components exported from SketchUp with CameraFollowBillboard glTF extras. All loaded categories are scanned for billboard nodes (the baked extras flag is the source of truth), so behaviour is robust to which category GLB the exporter bundled them into.
3dObject__Interaction__CameraFollowCompo.3dObject__Interaction__CameraFollow__Fla: Master switch for per-component flat shading. The flatness amount itself (0=full directional, 1=fully flat) is data-driven per component via the Components DataLib (Behaviours.ShadeFlatness) and baked into each billboard's glTF node extras as shadeFlatness. DefaultShadeFlatness is the fallback applied to billboards whose GLB predates the exporter field (no baked shadeFlatness) so existing models flatten without a re-export; any baked per-component value overrides it. Set FlatShadingEnabled to false to globally ignore flatness and render all billboards with normal directional lighting.

StoreyVisibility.StoreyVisibility__Description: Storey-based visibility toggle settings. Panel auto-detects storey models from GLB filenames containing Storey__ prefix.

LayoutEditor__Config.LayoutEditor__Config__Description: Layout Editor (re-alignment Phase E). Authoring is localhost-only (or an explicitly unlocked device); everywhere else the drawings and the project specification are shown by the read-only web viewer, which builds no panel columns, toolbar or tab strip at all. Switch the viewer off in LayoutEditor__WebViewer__Config in Na__LayoutEditor__AppConfig__.json to hand the web build back the read-only editor.
